title: Input Current Expression
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct expression for the intensity of the input current to the antenna.

title: Power Relation
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly relate the average power to the current and resistance using P = I^2 R.

title: Impedance Derivation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must derive the expression for the real part of the antenna impedance correctly.

title: Numerical Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must compute the numerical value for the impedance using the given parameters.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the equations.
